views.markdown:
A volume controller with a slider for media, ringer, alarm & calls.

* open it by holding or double pressing a volume button, or double tapping the home screen.
* get a slider for every output device used.
* reorder, hide & resize the sliders.
* remember media & ringer levels for each output.
* scroll long labels & round the slider corners.
* hide the iOS volume HUD while it is open.
* close on its own after a delay.

* show the package icon after install.
* add a Tip on Ko-fi row to the credits.
* list the features in the description.
